title: Billy Meier's early photos show the sport model

tellings.quote: think the initial pictures Billy Meier took um of the sport model looking craft are 100% genuine.

plain: Bob Lazar, who says he worked on alien craft at a secret Nevada site called S4, believes that Billy Meier's first photos, taken in the 1970s, are "100% genuine." Meier is a man who photographed what he said were alien craft. Lazar tells Michels the craft in those pictures looks like the one he calls the "sport model," one of the craft he says he saw. If so, the same kind of craft would have been photographed in public years before Lazar came forward.
